what: [runtime][latent] #14101 made src/runtime/trail_vol.py drop the forming bar before ranking ATR over vol_pctl_window (200, min_periods=window), but the exit monitor fetches exactly limit=200 bars (src/main.py:_build_monitor_ohlcv_fetcher, fetch_candles(..., limit=200)). Whenever the monitor's last bar is still forming -- nearly every pass -- the trimmed frame has 199 rows, the percentile is NaN, and resolve_vol_trail_mult returns the base mult (fail-permissive). So a vol_trail declare would be SILENTLY INERT live. No effect today (vol_trail is undeclared on every live leg), but #14053 plans to declare it on ada_pullback_2h and depends on #14101. FIX: monitor fetch limit >= vol_pctl_window + 1 (201), or fetch window+1 only for legs declaring trail_vol_*; add a guard test that a forming-bar monitor frame of the fetched length yields a defined percentile. The entry-side twin of this exact trap is handled in PR for PI-20260929-EXITOPS-0005 (_entry_fetch_limit).
